slides.heading: You change something most weeks. A new split, then a calorie cut.
slides.supporting: Now you cannot tell what actually worked.

slides.heading: Volyume checks whether there is really enough to act on before it changes anything.
You log your training. The weekly coaching reads that and your food, and says change, or hold.
Plenty of weeks it says hold, because there is not enough in your data yet to justify a change.

appShot.label: Your plan, changed only with a reason.

slides.heading: When there is not enough to go on, it holds and tells you why.
Volyume.
slides.supporting: Free to start on Google Play. The weekly coaching, with its food diary, is Pro.
